name: Multi-storey car park
desc: Concrete levels where meetings happen because nobody chose to be here.
tags: multi storey car park, concrete pillars, painted parking bays, low ceiling, fluorescent tubes, curving ramp, concrete parapet, stairwell door, oil stains on concrete, parked cars, city visible between the columns
prose: a level of a concrete multi-storey car park, painted bays between square pillars under low fluorescent tubes, a ramp curving down at the far end and the city showing past the open parapet
note: The open side is what says multi-storey rather than basement - keep the parapet and the city beyond it or you have simply rendered an underground garage. The low ceiling is the entire character of the space; drop that tag and the pillars start reading as a hall. Cars are optional, but an empty deck needs the bay markings or the scale collapses.
